# Northvale Zone Supplements

TEST FIXTURE ONLY. Synthetic text written for software evaluation; it is not part of any real corpus.

## 1 Zone A

Trips that end in Zone A need no supplement.

## 2 Zone B

Trips that end in Zone B need a supplement of 0.50 euros.

## 3 Zone C

Trips that end in Zone C need a supplement of 1.20 euros, and the ticket must be validated before boarding.
